takeaways.text: Lines up **Wide (outside)** on **70%** of 245 plays (n=172); also Slot 29% (n=72).
Runs a route on **99%** of dropbacks — about the WR average (100%). Effectively always a receiver; blocking is negligible.
On routes, averages **12.3 yd** downfield by the throw vs 11.2 for WRs (deeper) (n=240, snap→release window only).
Primary alignment is Wide (outside) (70%); a coach might set the first coverage answer to that spot. This is a hypothesis from observed tendencies, not a proven assignment.

example_plays.why: closest to his median route depth (11.5 yd) — a normal rep
farthest from his median depth — an outlier, NOT representative
